title: Multiband Combiner
text: 频移并合并信号，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Frequency offsets (Hz)} 指定频率偏移 [0；{Input sample rate (Hz)} 指定输入信号采样率 1e6、{Rate options} 指定处理速率选项 Enforce single-rate、{Output sample rate options} 输出采样率、{Output sample rate (Hz)} 输出信号采样率 3e6、{Output delay (samples)} 输出延迟 Read-only，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 输入信号 N samp -by- N chan matrix

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输出信号 N out -by-1 vector

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 输入信号采样率 1e6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Frequency offsets (Hz)
params.values: 频率偏移 [0 1e6] (default) | scalar | 1-by- N chan vector

params.name: Rate options
params.values: 处理速率选项 Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Output sample rate options
params.values: 输出采样率选项 Auto (default) | Specify via property

params.name: Output sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 输出信号采样率 3e6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Output delay (samples)
params.values: 输出延迟 Read-only: 36 (default) | positive scalar
